neighbours.label: the content word of a fixed multiword preposition whose next word is certain: 'Apart (from)', 'in spite (of)', Arabic 'على الرغم (من)', also 'Due (to)', 'according (to)'
fire: The gallery sells paintings and prints by local artists throughout the year. Apart from selling art, it also runs evening classes, in spite of its small size.
وعلى الرغم من المطر الشديد خرج الناس إلى الشوارع للاحتفال بالعيد.
The hikers reached the summit in spite of the fog, and apart from one twisted ankle nobody was hurt.
استمرت المباراة على الرغم من انقطاع الكهرباء في الملعب لعدة دقائق.
The library stays open late during exams. Apart from lending books, it offers quiet rooms, in spite of recent budget cuts.
He finished the marathon in spite of the heat. Apart from a few blisters, he felt fine afterwards.
نجح الطالب في الامتحان على الرغم من مرضه الطويل وغيابه عن المدرسة.
The farm produces milk and cheese for the region. Apart from keeping cows, the family grows apples, in spite of the poor soil.
quiet: The gallery sells paintings and prints by local artists throughout the year. It also runs evening classes, although it is small.
خرج الناس إلى الشوارع للاحتفال بالعيد وكان المطر شديدا في المدينة.
The hikers reached the summit although it was foggy, and only one of them twisted an ankle.
استمرت المباراة بعد انقطاع الكهرباء في الملعب لعدة دقائق.
The library stays open late during exams. It lends books and offers quiet rooms, although its budget was cut.
He finished the marathon although it was hot. He had a few blisters but felt fine afterwards.
نجح الطالب في الامتحان بعد مرضه الطويل وغيابه عن المدرسة.
The farm produces milk and cheese for the region. The family keeps cows and grows apples, although the soil is poor.
